# 🏛️ Chapter 2: The Market System and Your Accounts

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
SEBI, exchanges, RTAs, KYC and what apps like Groww really are.

## Units in this chapter

1. [Who's Who in Indian Markets](/market-system/2.1-whos-who-in-indian-markets) - Meet the regulators, exchanges, depositories and institutions that keep Indian markets running.
2. [RTAs and the Money Trail](/market-system/2.2-rtas-and-the-money-trail) - Learn what KFintech and CAMS do, what a folio is, and where your money goes when you invest in a mutual fund.
